Your treatment journey

From first consultation to final restoration.

From first consultation to final restoration.

Every stage is carefully planned around your needs.

Arrange a consultation

Every stage is carefully planned around your needs.

Arrange a consultation

Consultation & Assessment

We discuss your concerns, examine your oral health and understand what you hope to achieve.

Digital Treatment Planning

3D imaging and digital scans help us assess your jawbone, teeth and bite before planning your treatment.

Treatment

Treatment follows your plan, with guided surgery or dynamic navigation for implants where appropriate.

Final Restoration & Care

Once healing is complete, your final restoration is fitted, followed by regular reviews and maintenance.
